plugins.name: pr-skills
plugins.description: Skills for pull requests and drupal.org projects: pr-fix (fix failing PRs in DDEV projects), pr-triage (list the PRs that need your review), setup-checkout (clone or update a checkout with DDEV), update-docs (README, docs and project page), setup-docs (MkDocs site for docs/) and create-release (tag and publish releases).
